integrity: Analytic proof independently checked at derivative and endpoint stages; finite numerical diagnostics are not used to establish infinite quantifiers; no empirical validation or independent audit.
limitations: Single-individual externally forced first-infection hazard, one instantaneous dose with exponentially waning protection, exactly specified gamma-mixture incidence and A in [100,500]; excludes coupled epidemics, actual vaccine guidance and noisy hazard estimation. Priority subject to incomplete historical full-text coverage.
title: A discontinuous two-date vaccination optimum under gamma-mixture epidemic pressure
